decision.summary: Two overlapping transient offsets in U (and correlated N/E) occur within allowed context: first onset ~518 with sharp drop and incomplete recovery, second onset ~548 with secondary dip. Neither shows a confirmed opposing return before their respective ends; both classified uncertain due to ambiguous or absent return phases.

intervals.observation: U drops sharply from ~0 to ~-2 over 3–4 samples near 520, with N and E showing correlated negative transients (N: ~-1.5, E: ~-0.5) peaking 518–522; interior shows slow rebound but no return to pre-event baseline by 542; opposing motion not observed before end of interval

Second U dip near 550 (~-1.8), preceded by partial recovery from first event; N/E show weaker co-transients; interior (552–558) remains offset below prior baseline; no clear opposing return observed before 562
